name: Stacked words
summary: Two to four words stacked in alternating colour and size that slam in one after another, for punchy title cards.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame; overrides at when set

params.name: text
params.note: words separated by | (or spaces); up to 4 lines

params.name: size
params.note: size of the big lines; odd lines are 70%

params.name: color
params.note: colour of the even lines; default style accent

author: krakujs
